mode disabling
When a ‘mode disabling’ is active, RTE and Basic Software Scheduler disables the start of mode disabling dependent ExecutableEntitys. The ‘mode disabling’ is active during the mode that is referenced in the mode disabling dependency and during the transitions that enter and leave this mode. See also section 2.2.

targets.why: Mode disablings active during transitions and modes
RTE disables start of mode disabling dependents
BswScheduler disables start of mode disabling entities
